evals.prompt: Independent dry run. Both memory servers are healthy. /forget In this repository only, forget my formatter preference. Describe the next step without executing any tools.
evals.expected_output: Asks which store to use before any memory calls; repository applicability is not a destination.
assertions: Asks workspace memories or global user memories before any memory reads or writes.
Does not infer workspace-memory from repository applicability.

evals.prompt: Independent dry run. User selected_user; repository brads-playground. user-memory graph: selected_user/topics/editor (local_context, observations: Prefers Vim keybindings; Uses a high-contrast theme); selected_user/repositories/brads-playground/topics/editor (local_context, observation: Uses default keybindings in this repository). workspace-memory contains selected_user/topics/editor with Prefers Vim keybindings. /forget In global user memories, forget my user-wide Vim keybinding preference. Propose tool calls without executing mutations.
evals.expected_output: Deletes only the exact user-wide keybinding observation on user-memory and verifies removal; preserves the theme, repository exception, ownership, and other store.
assertions: Targets selected_user/topics/editor on user-memory with delete_observations and the exact Prefers Vim keybindings string.
Preserves theme, repository exception, entities, ownership relations, and workspace-memory.
Proposes readback verification without executing mutations.

evals.prompt: Independent dry run.
